title: Quantum Computing Advances
description: Exploring the next generation of quantum algorithms for scalable computation.
pageHtml:
Quantum Computing Advances

This project explores how next-generation quantum algorithms can make large-scale computation more practical for emerging hardware.

Project overview

The work focuses on algorithm design, error reduction, and improving performance for medium-sized quantum systems.

Why it matters

These advances can enable new scientific simulations and optimization problems that classical computers struggle to solve.
